cases.source: Fictional invention: mechanical bin-lid opening indicator for workshop technicians who need to know whether a supply bin has been opened since a manual reset. Components: bin,lid,hinge,hinge-mounted lever,latch,spring,sliding visible flag,and thumb reset slider. Preferred embodiment: opening lid pivotslever,releaseslatch,springraisesflag; closinglid does not resetflag. Manualslider can relatch only when lid is closed,using a lever-notch interlock. No electronics,magnets,networking orAI. Optional disclosed variants: torsion versus tension spring,and bolt-on versus clip mount. Materials,tolerances,force values,dimensions,manufacturing steps and performance measurements unknown. Known alternative in this toy disclosure is a manually attached paper label; no actual prior-art search. Possible novelty candidate is the disclosed opening-release plus closed-lid-only manual-reset combination,not a proven novelty claim. Commercial use is generic workshop supply bins.
